subtitles.en: I guess on the point of higher yields and higher rates, you know, can equity markets continue to rally amidst now 5.5% rates?
subtitles.zh: 说到更高的收益率和利率，在目前5.5%的利率环境下，权益市场还能继续走强吗？

subtitles.en: Yeah. So, you know, our view from a city-weld CIO perspective is short answer, yes. The increase that we've seen in rates has been a confluence of a whole bunch of things, right?
subtitles.zh: 从花旗资管首席投资官团队的角度看，简短回答是：可以。利率上行是多重因素共同作用的结果。
en_highlights: confluence of a whole bunch of things

subtitles.en: When you think about, there's definitely inflationary pressures, though interestingly, the rise in US tenure has not actually been a huge increase in inflation expectations, it's actually been driven by real rates.
subtitles.zh: 确实存在通胀压力，但有趣的是，美国长期利率上行并非主要来自通胀预期，而是由实际利率推动。

subtitles.en: Now, a component of that is some of the concerns around fiscal discipline and budgets, but a lot of it is also just a reflection of good growth in the United States, and you're seeing that in different pockets of the world as well.
subtitles.zh: 其中一部分来自对财政纪律和预算的担忧，但很大程度上也反映了美国增长良好，全球其他地区也有类似表现。

subtitles.en: You know, for us, that good growth, inflation, kind of all leads to a really, really solid earnings picture, and that has been the predominant driver for equity markets this year.
subtitles.zh: 对我们来说，良好增长加上通胀，带来了相当扎实的盈利图景，这也是今年权益市场的主要驱动力。

subtitles.en: When you break down equity returns, the vast majority of it has been driven by earnings growth and not by multiple expansion, if anything, key e-multiples have actually come down this year.
subtitles.zh: 拆解权益回报来看，绝大部分来自盈利增长，而非估值扩张，实际上今年关键估值倍数还有所回落。

subtitles.en: It's true across the globe, it's not just a US story, where global markets are across different regions and different countries, and it's because earnings growth is outpacing the pace of price return.
subtitles.zh: 这不仅是美国的现象，全球不同地区和国家都是如此，因为盈利增长快于价格回报。
zh_highlights: 盈利增长快于价格回报

subtitles.en: And so we're actually seeing kind of like a good normalization, a little bit of a breather, if you will, as it relates to valuations, you're seeing some of the higher yield impact there,
subtitles.zh: 所以估值层面其实是一种良性正常化，甚至可以说是稍作喘息，也能看到更高收益率带来的影响。
en_highlights: a little bit of a breather

subtitles.en: but it's not overcoming any of what we're seeing in terms of fundamental strength.
subtitles.zh: 但这并没有压过我们所看到的基本面韧性。

subtitles.en: So I was going to ask that at what point does higher rates, at what point doesn't really impact corporate fundamentals at earnings growth?
subtitles.zh: 我想问的是，利率高到什么程度才会真正影响企业基本面和盈利增长？

subtitles.en: Yeah, it's a great question, and unfortunately there's no just like one number, right, psychologically the marketplace, and many of our clients, we're very focused on 5% tenure, or 5.5% already here.
subtitles.zh: 这是个好问题，可惜并没有一个单一数字。心理上，市场和很多客户都非常关注5%的长期利率，现在已经到5.5%了。

subtitles.en: I think you have re-throughs historically into impact on things like residential mortgages and the housing industry, we're kind of in a different regime today.
subtitles.zh: 历史上利率会传导到住宅按揭和地产行业，但今天我们处在不同的环境里。

subtitles.en: A lot of the growth has been driven by industrial and AI growth and cat-backs, and they're actually what we're seeing is the market is actually able to absorb a lot of it, not just higher rates, but also the large amount of debt that's been issued by hyper-scalers.
subtitles.zh: 很多增长来自工业和AI领域的扩张，市场其实能够消化这些，不仅是更高利率，还有大型科技企业发行的大量债务。

subtitles.en: And so when you put all of these things together, you're getting a lot of points of data in the marketplace that the market is actually willing to absorb it because the growth prospects are so strong.
subtitles.zh: 把这些放在一起看，市场愿意消化这些数据，因为增长前景足够强劲。

subtitles.en: So we're not currently concerned, but we are watching the pace, and just whether or not there's increased volatility that maybe just is more surprising to the market.
subtitles.zh: 所以我们目前并不担忧，但会关注节奏，以及是否出现让市场更意外的波动加剧。

subtitles.en: And so if it kind of continues, and if we can explain it through the confluence of grinding higher inflation, but also solid growth, that is still an okay picture for us.
subtitles.zh: 如果这种状态延续，并且可以用通胀缓慢上行加上稳健增长来解释，那对我们来说仍然是可以接受的图景。

subtitles.en: But if you get, let's say, and this is not our base case, a really aggressive monetary policy response that's way more than what the marketplace expects right now, that could drive a little bit of volatility and derail some of what we're seeing in price action right now.
subtitles.zh: 但如果出现远超市场预期的激进货币政策反应——这不是我们的基准情形——可能会带来一些波动，并打乱当前的价格走势。

subtitles.en: Now, when you look at medium-term, we still see a really good runway for earnings, but that could drive some volatility. And we actually haven't seen a huge amount of it related to typical September volatility.
subtitles.zh: 中期来看，我们仍看到盈利有不错的空间，但这可能带来一些波动。实际上，我们并没有看到太多典型的九月波动。

subtitles.en: And so there are things that we've been expecting in the marketplace that we've been positioning for, that the market continues to absorb a lot of this noise pretty well.
subtitles.zh: 所以有些我们一直预期并提前布局的事情，市场仍在很好地消化这些噪音。
